description: This Java class defines criteria and helper methods for searching Person entities based on attributes in the OpenMRS system. It includes methods for constructing predicates, adding joins, and retrieving configuration for match modes.

classes.name: PersonSearchCriteria
classes.description: Defines search criteria and helper methods for querying person attributes in the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: preparePredicateForAttribute
methods.description: Constructs a search predicate based on attribute value, voided status, and match mode.

methods.name: addAliasForAttribute
methods.description: Adds a join alias for the 'attributes' relation on a Patient entity within a specific join context.

methods.name: addAliasForAttributeType
methods.description: Adds a join alias for the 'attributeType' relation on an Attribute entity.

methods.name: getAttributeMatchMode
methods.description: Retrieves the configured match mode (ANYWHERE or EXACT) for attribute searching from global properties.
